create_Rfft2d_instance: create an Rfft2d module with a custom blocksize and interleaving option for blockwise 2D FFT
run_Rfft2d_forward: run the forward pass of Rfft2d to compute blockwise real FFT coefficients on a single channel tensor
run_Rfft2d_inverse: run the inverse method of Rfft2d to reconstruct the original tensor from FFT coefficients
review_Rfft2d_class: review the Rfft2d class to understand its blockwise 2D FFT and inverse FFT capabilities
test_Rfft2d_roundtrip: test the Rfft2d forward and inverse methods to verify lossless reconstruction of input tensors
